module.name: F5 SPK SNAT Pool
module.description: Creates F5SPKSnatpool custom resource for managing SNAT (Source Network Address Translation) pools with IP ranges and pool members.

required.reason: FLO provides F5SPKSnatpool CRD and controller

required.name: cluster_name
required.description: Name of the Kubernetes cluster (used for resource identification)

required.name: pool_name
required.description: Name for the SNAT pool resource

required.name: flo_ready
required.description: Dependency flag ensuring FLO is ready

required.name: ip_ranges
required.description: List of IP addresses or ranges for SNAT pool

optional.name: pool_members
optional.description: Specific IP addresses for pool members

key_outputs.name: pool_ready
key_outputs.description: Flag indicating SNAT pool is active

key_outputs.name: pool_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the created SNAT pool

key_outputs.name: pool_namespace
key_outputs.description: Namespace where SNAT pool is deployed
